usage: plot_part1_latency.py [-h] --summary SUMMARY --out OUT

Draw Part1 latency from an explicitly supplied archived summary CSV. Whiskers
are observed min/max, not confidence intervals. No benchmark is run.
Matplotlib is loaded only after CLI and output-isolation checks. Sources:
original recorded plotting script; AI assistance: ChatGPT8November2026,
CLI/output isolation repair with OpenAI Codex18November2026.

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --summary SUMMARY  Explicit archived benchmark_summary.csv; no new
                     measurements are generated.
  --out OUT          NEW output directory outside the repository and source
                     CSV directory.

usage: run_registered_spark_recheck.py [-h] --dev DEV --reference-dir
                                       REFERENCE_DIR [--out OUT]

Controlled replacement wrapper: explicit inputs and preflight ONLY. The
historical wrapper auto-discovered home folders, fitted classifiers and
replaced a result ZIP. This repaired wrapper never dispatches that operation.
The diagnostic source is retained next to it; no classifier is fitted here.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --dev DEV
  --reference-dir REFERENCE_DIR
                        Explicit directory containing archived
                        registered_fold1_keys.npz and
                        registered_fold1_LR_scores.npz; no private default.
  --out OUT             Optional NEW external preflight JSON; never a fit
                        output
